description: Deploy a static website for an agent: creates a canister on the Internet Computer, installs the FirstKey static host, uploads every file, and returns the live https URL. The agent is added as a controller of its site canister. One free deploy per agent principal, funded from the FirstKey deploy pool; files must fit in one call (total under ~1.4 MB decoded) — use deploy_upload_chunk for larger files.

agent.description: The agent's ICP principal — becomes a controller of the site canister.

files.description: Files to publish. Include at least index.html.

content_type.description: Optional MIME type; guessed from extension when omitted.

path.description: Site path, e.g. index.html or css/main.css

name: deploy_site
